headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalGapCount_cast
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  2 ≤ U → ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalGapCount r c U) = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.aggregateMixingAllowance r c U

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalSchedule_error_budget
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  2 ≤ U →
    2 ≤
        Fintype.card
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
      ∀ (h : ℕ),
        ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleSteps r c U L h) *
                ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleStepPrecision r c U L h)) +
              Math115.PhysicalFiniteWalk.massAllowance r U L *
                Real.exp
                  (-↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleSteps r c U L h) /
                    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.aggregateMixingAllowance r c U) +
            ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleTerminalPrecision h)) ≤
          ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ),
            ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleWord r c U L hr hc start h))
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
              ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)
